title: Evolution X on Xiaomi Pad 5 Android 16 Install — Full Steps
blurb: Evolution X on the Xiaomi Pad 5 — Android 16 on the tablet, from fastboot to first boot.
video_description:
Evolution X on the Xiaomi Pad 5 — Android 16 on the tablet, from fastboot to first boot. Same idea as flashing a phone, with a couple of tablet things to watch.

The Pad 5 is a fun one to flash because a custom ROM changes how the whole tablet feels: cleaner system, no heavy manufacturer layer on top, and updates that don't wait on anyone else. Everything here is a tablet image, so the files matter more than usual — a phone build will not boot on this thing. Get the right package, flash it in order, format data once, and then let the first boot do its slow thing in the background.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi Pad 5
🧩 ROM     : Evolution X (Unofficial)
🤖 Android : 16

🛠️ What You Need
• Xiaomi Pad 5 with an unlocked bootloader
• The Evolution X package built for the Pad 5
• ADB and Fastboot tool with the USB driver installed on your PC
• A full backup, because this wipes the tablet
• Enough charge to survive a long first boot

📝 Steps
1. Back up anything on the tablet you want to keep.
2. Set up the ADB and Fastboot tool on the PC and check the device is detected.
3. Boot the Xiaomi Pad 5 into fastboot mode.
4. Flash the Evolution X package for this tablet, in the order shown.
5. Reboot into recovery and format data.
6. Boot to system and let Android 16 finish its first start.
7. Check the basics afterwards — Wi-Fi, display, sound and anything you plug in.

⚠️ Where People Get Stuck
• Using a phone build. The Pad 5 needs an image built for the Pad 5, nothing else.
• Skipping format data and then sitting on the boot animation for ages.
• Flashing over a low battery, then losing the device halfway through the process.
